# Keep the Light 1.21.0

**See how far the whole batch has got.** While the queue runs, the top of the Queue tab shows which file it is on ("File 2 of 5"), how much of the batch is done and the time left for everything. Longer files count for more, so a 2-hour film moves the bar further than a 20-minute episode.

**Times on every file.** The running file shows its own progress and time left. Waiting files show a rough estimate such as "about 40 min", worked out from how fast similar files went. Finished files show how long they took.

Time estimates are also more accurate when a queue mixes 1080p and 720p files.
